business_scope.primary_industry_name: Franchise Licensing and Syrups Supply Chain for Bubble Tea Chains

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction; International Companies Registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Law heritage with subsidiary customary law; unified national statute for International Companies)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and Australia (in force)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and New Zealand (in force)
OECD/Council of Europe Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (effective for Vanuatu)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) (ratified by Vanuatu)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act (Cap. 252), enacted as Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended, together with the Financial Services Commission Act 1993; Anti-Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2006, as amended (including subsequent AML/CFT reform amendments); the VFSC AML/CFT Rules issued thereunder; and the beneficial-ownership record-keeping and registered-agent obligations imposed under the International Companies Act and its subsidiary regulations. The licensed Vanuatu registered agent must identify and verify every ultimate beneficial owner (natural person) before incorporation, pierce any intermediate corporate or nominee layers, and file or hold UBO records accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the Financial Intelligence Unit on lawful request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport for each natural-person director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public or authorized certifier in the person's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a Contracting State to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961) or Consular Legalization for documents originating from non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing legitimate source of funds and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the applicant's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, and certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent competent authority of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and organizational chart executed under penalty of perjury, covering every ownership layer up to the ultimate natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant and all intermediate shareholders, countersigned by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of signature plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where executed outside Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every director, shareholder, UBO, and authorized signatory against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the OFAC SDN List; (iii) FATF Public Statements and jurisdiction-level lists; (iv) EU restrictive measures; and (v) VFSC domestic enforcement actions and adverse media alerts. Identification of any PEP, PEP family member, or close associate triggers enhanced due diligence, independent source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval within the licensed registered agent's compliance function under the VFSC AML/CFT Rules prior to filing the incorporation application.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Companies Registry and Name Reservation Portal, accessible through vfsc.vu, operated by the Registrar of International Companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory corporate names must be expressed in Latin/Roman characters and may be registered in English, French, or Bislama. Foreign-script brand names (e.g., a Chinese bubble-tea trading mark) must be transliterated into a Latin-script English or French rendition for the statutory name; any vernacular or foreign-script commercial brand may additionally be recorded as a secondary 'other name' subject to availability. The name must end with a statutory suffix, namely 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', or the French equivalents 'Société Anonyme' or 'SA'. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered or reserved name on the national registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection, the applicant through its licensed registered agent may, within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, lodge a formal administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at the VFSC, annexing the proposed name, the rejection notice, and a legal memorandum demonstrating distinctiveness and compliance with the International Companies Act. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 10 business days. A further administrative review may be requested before the VFSC Board, and any final refusal remains subject to judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this franchisor and syrup-supply-chain licensing vehicle. The International Company must maintain a statutory registered office at the business address of a licensed registered agent in Port Vila; there is no statutory requirement for physical employee premises, local staff, or operational assets in Vanuatu. The registered agent's address fully satisfies the registered-office mandate, and the entity's Vanuatu substance is confined to the agent's office and statutory records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated annual probability below 5%); VFSC supervision is risk-based and exercised principally through licensed registered agents; unannounced physical on-site inspections are rare and are triggered predominantly by adverse intelligence, sanctions events, or complaint-driven circumstances.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended, particularly sections governing incorporation, registered office, share capital, directors and officers (ss. 5-27, 30-45)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC1) accompanied by a Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; incorporation may proceed with nominal share capital and shares issued as fully paid or credited as fully paid; no escrow account requirement applies to International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers adopt the Memorandum and Articles submitted with the Application for Registration and direct the registered agent to owe all statutory fees to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED that the Company issue and allot the shares subscribed to the initial shareholders as recorded in the share register, credited as fully paid. RESOLVED that the registered office as stated in the Application be adopted. RESOLVED that the persons identified in the register of directors and officers be appointed to their respective offices, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and carry on the franchising business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry - online name search and reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability inquiry through a VFSC licensed registered agent. Provide the intended corporate name, proposed activities related to franchise licensing and syrups supply chain, and confirmation that the name does not suggest prohibited banking, insurance or trust activities. Upon approval, pay the reservation fee and obtain the name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of due diligence from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, file a written submission to VFSC explaining the legitimate commercial purpose and resubmit with a modified name within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Authentication and Pre-submission of Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage the registered agent to conduct statutory due diligence, verify beneficial ownership, prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act, and execute the declaration of eligibility for registration as an International Company.
required_dossiers: Identity and address verification for directors and subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any typographical or statutory inconsistency identified by the registered agent and re-notarize the signature paginated within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the Application for Registration (Form IC1) together with the Memorandum, Articles, registered agent consent, and statutory declaration. Pay the official filing fee and any expedited service fee via authorized wire transfer. No escrow deposit is required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query, submit a response letter with supporting legal exhibits within 14 days; VFSC shall issue the certificate once the query is resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Indexing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the company number and date of incorporation. Verify that the registered office, directors, officers and shareholders are entered into the public index. Obtain certified copies of the Certificate and registered documents for banking and franchise counterparties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate omits any key detail, file a rectification request supported by the certificate copy and original application within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt written resolutions to approve share allotment, appoint directors and officers, adopt the common seal if desired, approve bank account opening, and authorize the franchise licensing and syrups supply chain agreements. Minutes and registers should be maintained at the registered office of the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a register or minute is defective, prepare corrected entries and have the board ratify them retroactively in a supplementary resolution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in coordination with the Department of Industry of the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Food and Beverage Franchise Operations and Syrup Manufacturing (issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 240])

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) of the Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Ports
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Preliminary Environmental Assessment) for low-risk food beverage manufacturing and warehousing; a Full EIA Report is required if bottling or syrup production exceeds 1,000 metric tons per year or involves boiler emissions or chemical storage above prescribed thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater pH must be within 6.0-9.0; biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) not exceeding 30 mg/L; total suspended solids (TSS) below 50 mg/L; VOC emissions must not exceed 20 mg/m3 in vented air; all waste syrups and packaging must be segregated and disposed through approved permitted facilities

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services; structural load clearance from Public Works Department for production and warehousing floors; Occupational Safety and Health clearance covering franchise kitchens, syrup handling, staff welfare facilities, and electrical compliance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; offshore entity registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222) via the VFSC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, which carries an automatic statutory tax exemption for offshore activities. Step 2: A Vanuatu TIN is not issued or required for an IC that derives no income from within Vanuatu, as it is statutorily exempt from national income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty. Step 3: If the IC carries on a taxable activity inside Vanuatu or elects voluntary VAT registration, submit the VAT registration application (Form VAT 1) to the VCIR and receive a VAT identification number (VAT ID) for filing and invoicing. Step 4: Obtain a business license where local physical presence exists through the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) or municipal/ provincial councils under the Business Licences Act 2018. Step 5: Maintain a registered agent in Vanuatu and file the annual VFSC confirmation fee; no income tax return is required for the tax-exempt IC unless it becomes VAT-registered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not maintain a US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election system. The IC is automatically classified as a non-resident offshore tax-exempt entity under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222) and the Income Tax Act is structured such that no national income tax exists for offshore companies. Available statutory mechanisms: (i) voluntary VAT registration election under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 (Cap 245) to enable input VAT recovery on local purchases; (ii) election to obtain a formal Tax Exemption Certificate from the VFSC for banking counter-party evidence; (iii) election to redomicile into or out of Vanuatu under Part IVA of the International Companies Act; (iv) no OECD Pillar Two, CFC, or hybrid mismatch elections are operative or available for a purely offshore franchise holding company.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover; registration is mandatory for any person, including a non-resident IC, making taxable supplies in Vanuatu above this threshold; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold with VCIR approval
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has no mandatory real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based e-invoicing clearance regime. The VCIR operates an electronic tax administration portal for online VAT return filing and tax payments, but taxpayers remain entitled to issue conventional sequentially numbered paper or PDF tax invoices. Every VAT invoice must contain the supplier VAT ID, customer details, invoice date, description of supply, tax rate, taxable value, and VAT amount. Franchise royalty invoices and export sales invoices must be retained in original form for five years to support zero-rating claims during VCIR audits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is claimable under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 (Cap 245) on: (a) goods physically exported from Vanuatu, including syrup concentrates, flavour powders, packaging, and franchise equipment, provided export occurs within the prescribed period and is evidenced by customs documentation; (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient for use wholly outside Vanuatu, including franchise royalty income, system licensing fees, training services, and global brand management services rendered by the IC to overseas boba tea franchisees; (c) supplies to designated international organizations. The franchise must hold contemporaneous evidence that the benefit of the service is enjoyed outside Vanuatu and that the royalty payer is a non-resident not making local use of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CEF/DEC Form filed with the Vanuatu Customs Division)
Bill of Lading or House Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of payment from overseas
Commercial Invoice linking goods to the IC VAT ID and export entry
Franchise Agreement, Royalty Statement, or Service Contract proving the offshore recipient and offshore use of the service
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes strict documentation-based scrutiny of zero-rating claims. Penalties and clawback consequences include: (i) under s. 44 of the VAT Act 1998 (Cap 245), a civil penalty of up to the greater of 200% of the tax evaded or VUV 200,000 per offence, plus default interest at the prevailing statutory rate; (ii) retrospective VAT assessments clawing back zero-rated output tax together with input VAT disallowance where export documentation is missing, forged, or does not show physical departure within the required period; (iii) under the Customs Act 1981, false or fraudulent export declarations attract fines up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; (iv) the VCIR may cancel the VAT ID and refer egregious abuse to the VFSC for revocation of the IC Tax Exemption Certificate; (v) directors and franchise principals may be personally liable for fraudulent misuse of zero-rating where franchise royalties are artificially structured as offshore services while the economic benefit occurs inside Vanuatu; (vi) no statutory FX repatriation deadline applies in Vanuatu, as International Companies enjoy unrestricted capital and payment flows pursuant to the International Companies Act 1992, but royalty remittance flows should, as a prudent benchmark, be received within 180 days to maintain clean audit evidence and support transfer-pricing substance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting under the Foreign Exchange Control Act [Cap 118], the International Companies Act [Cap 222], and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014, as the central bank and designated exchange control authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is effectively convertible on both current and capital account; the exchange control framework is liberalized and does not restrict profit remittance, dividend distribution, or royalty outflows for non-resident international companies (ICs). Since the 2021 RBV reform, the VUV is anchored to the U.S. dollar (approximately VUV 112.5 per USD), which substantially reduces USD translation risk for royalty and franchise fee inflows. A Vanuatu IC is statutorily treated as a non-resident for exchange control purposes and is therefore exempt from prior RBV approval for offshore current and capital transactions. Vanuatu levies no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or trade payments, creating a frictionless remittance corridor. Residual hurdles are limited to bank-level AML/CFT due diligence, FATF increased monitoring (grey-list) scrutiny, and correspondent bank risk appetite rather than statutory convertibility limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no export-proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no statutory repatriation timeline. Exporters and non-resident ICs may retain 100% of foreign-currency receipts in onshore or offshore foreign-currency accounts denominated in USD, AUD, EUR, or CNH. Banks require only transactional evidence (commercial invoice, bill of lading, signed franchise agreement, or LC documents) to demonstrate the underlying genuine trade or service flow.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency: VUV/USD/AUD); Capital Escrow Account not statutorily required as Vanuatu IC has no minimum capital obligation
Operational Account (VUV/USD) with dedicated SWIFT MT103/MT700 clearing capability and regional correspondent coverage
Operational Account (VUV/EUR/USD) suited to French and European franchise supply-chain flows
Private banking custodial and escrow account for franchise security deposits and IP holding treasury structures
Operational Account (retail-oriented); limited foreign-currency clearing capacity for cross-border franchise royalty and supplier payment flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility. Vanuatu has no domestic EMI licensing regime; an offshore or global EMI (e.g., Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer) will generally decline a Vanuatu IC due to grey-list risk appetite, lack of a VUV-denominated IBAN, and the entity's offshore classification. A fintech EMI may supplement, not replace, the primary banking rail for FX conversion or low-value disbursements if it accepts Vanuatu corporate clients; legally, any deposit-taking or payment-instrument activity targeting Vanuatu residents requires an RBV banking licence. Onshore licensed banks (ANZ and BSP) must remain the treasury anchor.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence in Port Vila is not statutorily mandated. RBV risk-based AML/CFT guidance permits remote onboarding: directors and ultimate beneficial owners may undergo a recorded video interview with the bank's compliance officer, with all identity documents notarized or apostilled. Enhanced due diligence, including a possible physical meeting or appointment of a local director/registered agent, may be imposed where the UBO is a politically exposed person, the jurisdiction of ultimate ownership is high risk, or source-of-wealth documentation is incomplete. A licensed Vanuatu registered agent must certify corporate good standing and beneficial ownership particulars.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu FATF increased monitoring (grey-list) status triggers automatic enhanced due diligence and possible de-risking by correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Jurisdictional compliance pack comprising VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, tax-exempt status letter under the International Companies Act, audited financial statements, detailed group structure chart, and formal engagement letter with a licensed Vanuatu registered agent attesting to beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC profile suggestive of a shell company, including potential bearer-share or nominee shareholder arrangements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance and ownership dossier: certified register of directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners; statutory declaration confirming no bearer shares are issued or outstanding; Vanuatu physical office lease or registered-agent services agreement; employment or contractor contracts evidencing local franchise and IP administration; annual compliance filings and corporate ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of initial capital injection for a newly incorporated IC with no operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth file: 12 to 24 months of personal and corporate bank statements of the UBO, formation capital transfer vouchers, sale or liquidation documentation of predecessor entities, and a sworn wealth declaration explaining the accumulation of capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring cross-border franchise royalty wires to or from related parties creating trade-based money-laundering red flags at the receiving bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transactional legal bundle: executed master franchise agreements, royalty calculation model (fixed fee per store or percentage of gross sales), intercompany trademark and syrup supply licence agreements, transfer-pricing benchmark memorandum, and annual audited financial statements for both the Vanuatu IC and the associated franchise entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Directors unable to attend a physical KYC interview in Vanuatu, delaying account activation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Remote-KYC completion file: notarized and apostilled passports and proof of residential address, certified corporate resolutions authorizing account opening, recorded video interview transcript, and a power of attorney granted to a local registered agent or licensed attorney for in-person attendance at the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share capital or shareholder loan injections are executed by SWIFT MT103 from the UBO's external bank to the IC's ANZ or BSP Vanuatu operating account, with the beneficiary information line stating 'Share capital contribution – [IC name], VFSC Certificate No. [number]' and the receiving bank classifying the purpose as direct investment/capital contribution in its RBV statistical reporting. A certified extract of the directors' resolution authorizing the account and capital structure, together with the UBO's source-of-funds statements, must be delivered to the bank before or at transfer. No prior RBV exchange-control approval applies to a non-resident IC; the bank may file a statistical notification only. For the Local_POS rail applicable to the bubble tea franchise, Vanuatu store sales are settled in VUV through local EFTPOS/POS acquiring and swept periodically into the USD operating account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for syrup, boba ingredients, and packaging follow a dual rail: (1) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfer for payables below USD 25,000, supported by supplier pro-forma invoices and beneficiary bank details; and (2) irrevocable at-sight documentary credits (commercial LC, SWIFT MT700) for larger shipments, supported by commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, and phytosanitary certificates where applicable. The preferred clearing corridor is ANZ's network via Sydney or New York, or BSP's regional correspondent chain; CNY-denominated supplier payments are effected through a CNH conversion at a licensed VUV/USD/CNH treasury desk. No exchange-control approval is required for outbound IC payments, and Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on outbound trade or royalty remittances; the payee's local withholding rules remain the only tax friction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: VUV/USD deliverable outright forwards (vanilla) executed with licensed onshore commercial banks (ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Ltd, BSP Vanuatu) to hedge recurring USD royalty conversion
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV with offshore investment bank counterparties, used because the onshore forward market is thin and NDF settlement is USD-based
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD/AUD/CNH) with onshore banks to match USD royalty inflows against CNY supplier liabilities, including net-settlement USD legs
Natural hedging via multi-currency operating accounts (USD, AUD, CNH) and matched invoice currencies for franchise fees and supply purchases to minimize spot conversions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and payment of the Annual Licence Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), submitted through the appointed licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual Licence Fee due no later than the anniversary of incorporation; Annual Return must be lodged within 30 days after each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs VFSC penalties, typically 10% per month on the unpaid annual fee; continued default for 12 months may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent AML/CFT annual beneficial ownership review and customer due diligence confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent; no direct filing to VFSC unless a suspicious transaction is reported
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the anniversary-based review date, as set out in the registered agent engagement letter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-cooperation may cause the registered agent to resign as agent and registered office provider, which in turn exposes the company to administrative strike-off and loss of corporate capacity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act 1993; an audit is not statutorily mandated regardless of revenue, assets, or shareholder base, unless required contractually or under a separate VFSC licence held by the entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory IFRS filing applies to International Companies; accounting records must merely be sufficient to explain transactions and disclose the financial position with reasonable accuracy. IFRS may be voluntarily adopted for internal or lender reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On or before each anniversary, the registered agent must re-identify and confirm beneficial owners, directors, and material shareholders. Share transfers are recorded in the company's internal share register and relayed to the registered agent; VFSC does not maintain a public UBO registry for International Companies.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (minutes of shareholders' and board meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700–1,200 per year for the licensed registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 because statutory audit is not mandatory; voluntary certified audit, if commissioned, typically ranges from USD 2,500 to USD 5,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu International Company; full exemption under International Companies Act No. 33 of 2007, s.80)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax on offshore franchise royalties and supply-chain revenue for qualifying International Companies; no net wealth or annual property tax on foreign-source receipts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return (Form 11) under International Companies Act 2007; filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the VFSC Online Registry electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; no extension available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and unique VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name and number exactly as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the licensed registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a licensed agent's physical office address; PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and signature of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent must be a Vanuatu-licensed lawyer, accountant, or FSP who attests to identity verification and beneficial ownership checks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationalities, share class, and % holding for each shareholder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must declare ultimate beneficial owners; VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register filing is mandatory under the Companies (Amendment) Act 2022.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationality, and appointment dates of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minimum one director; director may be non-resident or a corporate body, but a resident registered agent is still required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Statement of No Vanuatu Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not conducted business with Vanuatu residents, held Vanuatu land, or transacted with a domestic Vanuatu license holder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration triggers immediate loss of tax exemption; global franchise activity must be performed entirely outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of payment of the government annual registration fee and VFSC recurrent licensing fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are payable in VUV via the registered agent; failure voids the filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location of accounting records and the appointed record-keeper.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records may remain offshore but must be produced at the registered office within 7 days of a VFSC written demand.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts graduated VFSC late fees commencing on day 31 after the anniversary, escalating daily surcharges, automatic warning notice, and involuntary striking-off at 90 days. Reinstatement requires a court application and restoration fees up to VUV 50,000 plus director disqualification orders.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; IC Act 2007 s.80 exemption applies to all dividends and distributions)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network; the only DTA is the Australia-Vanuatu agreement limited to shipping and air transport. No treaty relief protocol or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) requirement exists for dividend flows from Vanuatu. Inbound treaty relief must be pursued solely in the franchisee's home jurisdiction using a Vanuatu Certificate of Residence issued by the VFSC, evidencing that Vanuatu has no residual taxing right.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for boba tea brand licences, recipes, and supply-chain system licences: 0% statutory rate in Vanuatu; 0% interest withholding on shareholder loans sourced from the IC. Recipient jurisdiction withholding taxes (0%-30%) apply, reducible only via any bilateral investment treaty or unilateral foreign tax credit in the payee's residence country.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold or Local File / Master File obligation under Vanuatu law; recommended administrative threshold of VUV 100,000,000 in related-party royalty and supply-chain revenue to evidence arm's-length conduct and satisfy foreign tax authority audits.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No dedicated Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime exists in Vanuatu; however the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022, VFSC beneficial-ownership rules, and EU/OECD transparency screening effectively require demonstrable offshore substance: licensed registered agent, board governance, accounting records, and management decisions outside Vanuatu. The boba tea franchise IC must maintain a functional treasury and licensing contract archive to avoid characterization as a tax-evasion shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Tax-Exemption Claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: IC transacts with Vanuatu residents, owns Vanuatu land, or files a false Statement of No Vanuatu Business while claiming the s.80 exemption; or franchise royalty streams are diverted through layered nominees to conceal taxable economic activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of International Company status; retrospective reassessment at the standard corporate tax rate (0% statutory but loss of exemption exposes fees and penalties); VFSC strike-off; fines up to VUV 500,000 per false declaration plus VUV 5,000 daily continuing penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of all unpaid taxes and penalties; courts may issue asset-freezing orders, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 2 years for false statutory declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Substance and AML Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the franchise licensing and syrup supply chain through a bare nominee IC with no board minutes, no accounting records, undisclosed beneficial ownership, or unlicensed registered agent; accepting franchise royalty wires without AML/KYC verification of counterparty franchisees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act No. 30 of 2017: corporate fines up to VUV 10,000,000 per contravention; VFSC cancellation of registration and freezing of royalty collection bank accounts; referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit for suspicious transactions exceeding VUV 1,000,000 without disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors face personal fines up to VUV 10,000,000, imprisonment up to 15 years, confiscation of personal assets under proceeds-of-crime legislation, and criminal travel bans pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Foreign franchisee regulators or tax authorities classify the Vanuatu IC as a passive offshore shell; failure to maintain sufficient substance to rebut CFC / PATGI / Sec. 162(m) characterization in franchisee countries; re-domiciliation of intellectual property without economic justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu-side administrative strike-off and director disqualification for failure to furnish records to VFSC; foreign-side penalty taxes of 20%-40% on gross boba tea royalties, retroactive transfer-pricing adjustments, and reputational listing on EU blacklists or OECD harmful-tax reviews.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign courts may pierce the corporate veil, subjecting directors and controllers to personal tax assessments equal to unpaid withholding taxes plus interest, civil restitution of the full royalty stream, and extradition or international arrest warrants for tax fraud where criminal intent is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Franchise Licensing and Consumer Protection Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling master franchise licences in multiple territories without valid trademark registration, misrepresenting tax-exempt status to franchisees, or collecting franchise fees while failing to pay the required VFSC annual fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil liability under Vanuatu consumer protection and trade licensing frameworks; VFSC licence suspension; clawback of franchise fee payments; criminal prosecution for obtaining financial advantage by deception with corporate fines up to VUV 2,000,000 and full restitution orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors liable in personam for franchisee contractual damages and fraudulent misrepresentation torts; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 10 years, director disqualification for 7 years, and non-dischargeable restitution obligations.
